name: Install it in Chrome
desc: Search the Chrome Web Store for “Inspiration Collector”, add it to Chrome, then pin it to the toolbar.

name: Open the panel, pick a folder
desc: Click the toolbar icon to open the side panel. The first time, pick a folder and allow it once in Chrome.

name: Save a whole page
desc: “Save page” in the side panel saves the whole article as one item. Saving the same page twice still leaves one copy.

name: Save a passage
desc: Select a few sentences, right-click the highlight and choose “Save selection to Collector”. One passage, one item.

name: Save images
desc: Right-click to save one image at full size; use “Images” to pick several. Small icons are skipped.

name: Save one AI reply
desc: “Save this”, at the end of each reply in ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, saves just that reply.

name: Save a whole AI chat
desc: “Save page” on a chat saves the whole conversation, marked with who said what. Perplexity keeps its sources too.

name: Save files ChatGPT made
desc: “Files” saves the original xlsx, py and md files ChatGPT made into assets/. It is greyed out on other sites.

name: Sort with topics
desc: “New topic” makes a folder and a sentence on what it is for, written to MATERIAL.md. You can change it any time.

name: Move between topics
desc: Breadcrumbs show where you are, and every level is clickable. “Switch topic” changes topic; “Change folder” changes where everything is saved.

name: Tidy the list
desc: “List” or “Grid”, ALL / TXT / IMG / FILE, search and “On this page”. Delete takes two clicks.

name: What is in the folder
desc: One .md per item, original files in assets/. Every item records its source at the top; MATERIAL.md explains the folder to your AI.

name: Hand it to your AI
desc: After five items, “hand it to your AI” appears: paste the path, copy the prompt and paste it into Claude Code. It reads everything and returns a sourced outline (from a real run).

name: When the folder is locked
desc: Left idle, the folder locks: click “Unlock folder”. If the side panel cannot unlock it, the lock icon at the top opens a separate page.

name: Page tools off, clearing data
desc: Turning “Page tools” off removes the buttons on web pages; the side panel still saves. The trash icon shows what will be deleted first.

name: Help and support
desc: “How it works”, “Get help” (checks everything on the spot), “Privacy” and “About me”.
